study: M8 referee-history vs Crown T12 AH; retrospective assignment upper-bound diagnostic, not proof of pre-match availability

method.target: home one-unit net AH payout minus away one-unit net AH payout
method.time_split: 2024/2025/2026 test folds train only on earlier calendar years; prior referee features exclude target day and previous two calendar days
method.referee_feature: within-league historical mean(home goals - away goals + Crown home AH line) minus prior within-league mean residual, shrunk n/(n+20); plus log(1+n)
method.referee_name_join: strict exact Crown league/team crosswalk, date +/-1 day, exact FT check, normalized name as league-scoped key
method.stake: 1U per selected AH side; Crown quarter-lines split into two equal half-line stakes
method.frozen_membership: FID exclusion is post-hoc incremental attribution only; not a model feature

actual_receipt.model_replay_status: not evaluable as a true pre-match referee-information test; target assignment has no publication/receipt timestamp and source data ends before the 2026-10/11 receipt window
